description: Rewrites a draft, article, or piece of writing in Jordan Rash's personal voice — conversational, candid about struggle, plainspoken, lightly imperfect rather than corporate-polished. Activates on the literal command "/myvoice", and also on "rewrite this in my voice", "make this sound like me", "apply my writing style", "redraft in my tone", or "run this through myvoice". Do NOT use for purely factual/data tasks with no prose to restyle (spreadsheets, raw data pulls, calendar lookups) — use the relevant productivity skill instead. Do NOT use to draft content from scratch with no source text — ask for or gather a draft/topic first, then restyle it.
